title: Pyne Pod 2in1 Mango Ice Prefilled Vape Pods - Pod Salt Edition
description: This Mango Ice Pod Pack for the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 Kit delivers a tropical vape with a cool, clean finish. The Mango offers rich, sun-soaked sweetness with soft, juicy notes, while the Ice element adds a chilled exhale that enhances the fruit’s lush, bright character. It’s a smooth, flavourful blend that balances sweetness with a refreshing exhale. Each pod is prefilled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and made for use with the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 device. The pods connect magnetically and are fully compatible with the twist-activated dual pod system. With two pods per pack, Mango Ice is ideal for those who enjoy exotic fruit flavours with a cool and breezy finish.
